answer: The pearl history is re-read at each close, comet lists the contradictions, and river records the voided pairs. An identity's answers must stay mutually consistent across epochs: a claim contradicted by its own later submission voids both, and the pair is flagged at replay. A farm that generates text cheaply cannot hold a coherent position over 18 epochs, and hence its own output eventually convicts it. A farm of 159 pays that 250 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
